name: Hornero Studio Jobs
description: Render and export job monitor for HorneroOS Studio: shows queued, running, finished and interrupted jobs from the typed horneroctl studio jobs contract. Read-only; jobs are submitted and cancelled from the CLI or Control Center.
author: HorneroOS contributors

refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between reads of the Studio job list.

maxRows.description: Most jobs listed, newest first as horneroctl reports them.

showAdapter.description: Show the tool that runs each job (ffmpeg, blender) before its state.

showFinished.description: Keep succeeded, failed and cancelled jobs in the list; off shows only queued and running ones.

changelog.notes: Typed settings: refreshSeconds, maxRows, showAdapter, showFinished (defaults keep the 2.0 behaviour: 30 s, four rows, adapter shown, finished jobs kept).
PluginKit 3 on Hornero Signal: instrument module with Hornero Glyph state icons in palette roles and an on-air chip for running jobs.
Rebuilt on PluginKit: native card header, empty and unavailable states, one row per job with a semantic state icon. Needs Hornero Shell 1.2.72 (PluginKit UiIcon/iconName/card header).
